moat.body:

- distribution: Pan-India hub-and-spoke network with a large fleet mix enabling nationwide coverage — evidence: distribution network of 32 branches across India, own fleet of 110 commercial vehicles plus around 18,000 vehicles hired from the local market
- resource: Headquartered in Chhattisgarh, a concentrated steel and cement manufacturing belt — …

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- India's logistics costs are estimated at approximately 13-14% of GDP versus 8-10% in developed economies, constraining the sector's global competitiveness.
- Sub-optimal modal mix with excessive reliance on road transport, fragmented regulatory and institutional frameworks, gaps in warehousing and multimodal connectivity, shortage of skilled manpower and sub-optimal fleet capacity, and inadequate intermodal/last-mile connectivity infrastructure.
- Disruptions in key maritime routes (including the Red Sea), changing tariff regimes and trade policy uncertainties led to longer transit times, higher shipping costs and supply chain realignments during FY 2025-26.
- Cited as operational challenges affecting the global freight transport and logistics sector during the year.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Focus on customer centricity, operational excellence, prudent financial management, technology adoption and sustainable expansion
- Sharpen operational efficiencies and strengthen cost discipline to improve profitability after a year of profitability pressure
- Disciplined approach towards capital allocation and risk management while evaluating opportunities that strengthen competitive position
- Continue to remain responsive to industry digitisation and technology adoption trends and evolve capabilities to meet changing customer requirements
